_note: Invented tickets for the first probe. No real people or data. 'expected' is your own judgment, written before running Jev.

tickets.title: Laptop won't connect to VPN
tickets.description: Since this morning my laptop says 'authentication failed' when I start the VPN. I'm working from home and can't reach anything internal.

tickets.title: Gantt chart crashes on large projects
tickets.description: Customer Acme reports the Gantt view freezes and shows a blank page when a project has more than 500 tasks. Started after Tuesday's release.

tickets.title: Charged twice this month
tickets.description: Our company card was charged twice for the March subscription. Please refund one of the charges.

tickets.title: Expense reimbursement missing
tickets.description: I submitted my train tickets for the client visit six weeks ago and still haven't been paid back.
tickets.expected: hr (hard: money, but it's an employee's own expenses)

tickets.title: Weird email asking for my password
tickets.description: Got an email that looks like it's from IT asking me to 'confirm my password' on a link. I clicked it and typed my password before I noticed the domain was wrong.

tickets.title: Customer wants all their data deleted
tickets.description: A customer emailed asking us to delete all personal data we hold about their users under GDPR, and wants written confirmation.

tickets.title: Interested in the Enterprise plan
tickets.description: We're 120 people and want to move from Team to Enterprise. Can someone send a quote and show us SSO?

tickets.title: Heating broken on floor 3
tickets.description: It's 15 degrees on the third floor and the radiators are cold.

tickets.title: Problem with my team lead
tickets.description: My team lead keeps making comments about my age in meetings. I'd like to talk to someone about it confidentially.

tickets.title: Lunch recommendations?
tickets.description: Anyone know a good place for team lunch near the office on Friday?

tickets.title: API key leaked in public repo
tickets.description: One of our engineers pushed a production database key to a public GitHub repo an hour ago. The repo is still public.

tickets.title: Invoice shows wrong VAT number
tickets.description: Our invoice for April has our old VAT number. Our procurement can't pay it until it's corrected.

tickets.title: Add dark mode
tickets.description: Our team works late and would love a dark theme in the web app.

tickets.title: Whole app down for all customers
tickets.description: Status page is green but every customer we talk to gets a 502 error on login. Support phone lines are full.

tickets.title: Contract renewal terms
tickets.description: Customer's legal team wants to change the liability clause before renewing, and asks if we can also give them a 10% discount.
